crossRefs.note: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the…
Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,
Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.
That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

translations.web: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.
translations.bsb: Otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—to say nothing of you—would be ashamed of having been so confident.
translations.kjv: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that ➔ we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
translations.asv: lest by any means, if there come with me any of Macedonia and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be put to shame in this confidence.
